# goodpkg

The goal of goodpkg is to add the list of strings , and this is the
result of my little attempt.

## Installation

You can install the goodpkg in my web:

<https://github.com/s2fxr8mrxx-jpg/mypkg>

``` r
# FILL THIS IN! HOW CAN PEOPLE INSTALL YOUR DEV PACKAGE?
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r
library(goodpkg)
print(add(c("this ", "function ", "is ok")))
#> this function is ok
```

## All functions

  Title a function to paste string list like paste0
